paragraphs: Rabbi Apas was of Rabbi’s court and sat at the head after Rabbi’s death, two and a half years older than Chanina bar Chama, his successor. Berakhot, Mi Shemeto; Ketubbot 103b; Shabbat 59b. Rashi’s “two years” should include a half. Jerusalem Ta'anit 4:2; part I, 3980, 3990. Rabbi asked Apas to write a letter to Antoninus and then tore it. Bereshit Rabbah 75:5 [cited here as chapter 4]. Oshaya in his name; Resh Lakish and Chanina’s students asked him (see Levi, Resh Lakish); Chanina. Colleagues: Rabbi’s sons Gamliel and Shimon; Oshaya b.Ch. [ב״ח; patronym unresolved]; Elazar Hakkappar. Shalshelet Hakkabbalah 33b calls Oshaya, Gamliel, and Shimon all Rabbi’s sons. Mistaken; see Berabbi for its origin.
